transfer_scenarios: Simulator throughput is high and parity-tested
Checkpoint evaluation is stable enough to detect progress
Compute and deployment compression budgets are available
Actions naturally decompose into candidate selection and magnitude
A deterministic converter can map the semantic target back to legal low-level controls
Players share rules and observation schema
Entity order can be represented with masks rather than fixed slots

trick_highlights: Scale model capacity only after simulator and PPO correctness are established: A high-throughput simulator and expressive transformer let additional model capacity and self-play steps absorb complex game dynamics that a small hand-engineered policy could not.. Implementation: Prototype with 1-5M parameter models, then scale to a 200M, 38-layer, 768-dimensional, 16-head transformer trained for about 15B self-play steps with distributed PPO.

Keep observations low-level while factorizing an intractable action space: Selecting a semantic target entity removes difficult continuous geometric search while retaining entity-level state information and a continuous fleet-size decision.. Implementation: Replace raw launch-angle prediction with source-target attention over valid planets, then condition an eight-component truncated logistic mixture on the selected target to sample fleet size.

Use a shared entity-token transformer for all players: Player, global, actor-plan, critic-value and scratch tokens share context with all entities, allowing symmetric multi-player decisions and values from one trunk execution.. Implementation: Project planets, fleets and comets to a shared hidden dimension; concatenate player/global/scratch/actor/critic tokens; run one transformer; decode each player's actor and winner probability.

Rewrite the simulator only with replay-level parity gates: A Rust vector environment increases rollout throughput, while reference-transition tests prevent silent divergence from Kaggle's Python game implementation.. Implementation: Run environments and observation writes in parallel with Rayon, reuse pinned Python buffers, and replay real Kaggle transitions through the Rust rules engine before comparing complete state and terminal results.

Promote checkpoints by opponent wins and reuse last-best as a teacher: A moving last-best checkpoint supplies a concrete self-play progress gate and a stabilizing policy/value target without introducing external demonstrations.. Implementation: Evaluate current versus last-best in mixed 1v1 and 2v2 games; replace last-best above 70% win rate; add teacher action KL and winner-distribution cross-entropy terms to PPO.

Co-design training, compression and runtime fallback: Submission quality is maximized by optimizing the complete constrained agent rather than the uncompressed training checkpoint in isolation.. Implementation: Use groupwise four-bit NormalFloat checkpoint compression, dynamic int8 CPU linear layers, bounded visible fleets and an overage-triggered 5M fallback model.

Use coding agents as an implementation multiplier, not a research oracle: Agentic coding sharply reduces implementation latency in a greenfield, low-stakes competition, but architecture, experiments and branch selection still require human research judgment.. Implementation: Write explicit specifications and generated documentation, isolate risky branches, and discard failed codebases instead of endlessly layering experiments into one mutable tree.
Negative evidence - Undiscounted returns encouraged stalling: With gamma=1, a winning policy had no incentive to finish early, so already-decided episodes consumed training compute.

Negative evidence - Short-term ladder composition was mistaken for the final opponent distribution: Raising the two-player training mixture to 90% and omitting league play overfit the observed pre-deadline matchmaking distribution; the top ladder later became four-player-heavy.
Negative evidence - A hard mask for obviously bad launches reduced learned policy quality: Removing bad actions may also remove pressure to learn the underlying physics representation.
Negative evidence - Three-bit compression did not justify a larger model: Additional model capacity was outweighed by larger policy distortion from lower-bit quantization.

Negative evidence - The current repository snapshot is not an immutable copy of the exact winning submission: The public repository continued evolving after the competition solution, so later LoRA, reward and quantization features cannot automatically be credited to the submitted agent.
entries.summary: The leading Orbit Wars solution scaled pure self-play PPO to a 200M-parameter entity transformer and roughly 15B environment steps. Its strongest reusable lesson is systems-level co-design: structured target actions, one-pass multi-player modeling, a Rust vector environment verified against Kaggle replays, last-best checkpoint evaluation and distillation, distributed training, and deployment-aware quantization/fallback. The write-up also supplies unusually valuable negative evidence on gamma=1 stalling, matchup-distribution shift, action masks, three-bit quantization and missing league play.
